headline.description: A short, high-impact statement summarizing the product’s core value for the target market.

subheadline.description: A supporting sentence or brief expansion on the headline, offering more context or clarity.

benefits.description: A list of 3–5 factual, product-based advantages derived directly from the product page.

details_paragraph.description: A short explanatory paragraph giving additional context, fit guidance, or descriptive detail.

story.description: A narrative paragraph describing the product’s creation, purpose, or emotional context.

reassurance_block.description: Copy that highlights trust-building elements such as return policy, comfort guarantee, or durability assurance.

footer_note.description: Short reassurance or legal text, such as return policy or warranty note.

spec_table.description: A list of {label, value} pairs describing technical or material specifications from the product page.

comparison_points.description: A list of comparison rows showing 'before' vs 'after' improvements provided by the product.

cards.description: A list of card objects, each containing a title, short description, and two bullet points describing a use-case or variant.

layout_descriptions.persona_fit: Best for busy, minimalist shoppers who want to understand the core value in a few seconds and dislike wordy or complex pages.
layout_features: Single hero section with strong headline and short subheadline
Very limited body copy; focuses on brevity and clarity
One compact benefits list with 3 bullets
Single prominent primary CTA
Minimal footer note for reassurance or legal text
